violation_type.title: Children Handwashing After Feeding or Touching Animals (26 TAC §744.2517(6))
violation_type.short_title: Children Handwashing After Feeding or Touching Animals
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection a parent brought in a dog and the children were observed petting it then failed to wash hands after.

finding_variants.text: During inspection a parent brought in a dog and the children were observed petting it then failed to wash hands after.
